## Ea security-controlled change

### Data and communication boundary
- [ ] No email bodies/attachments, calendar data, CRM exports, customer records, credentials or sensitive personal data are included.
- [ ] No external email, invitation, commercial commitment or connector write is activated by this repository change.
- [ ] Repository transfer and visibility change are excluded.

### Validation
- [ ] Active-source/canonical-rule authority was checked.
- [ ] New or modified Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs and use minimum permissions.
- [ ] Logs, examples and evidence were redacted and checked for personal/customer data.
- [ ] Approval, fail-closed and rollback behavior were verified.

### Status
- [ ] Implementation log updated.
- [ ] Unverified controls remain `PENDING_REVIEW`.

Describe security/privacy impact, evidence and manual GitHub settings still required.
